```plato

    // True when the graph holds every possible simple edge. Precondition: the
    // graph is simple (no self-loops or parallel edges)
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Complete_graph).
    IsComplete(self: IGraph): Boolean
        => self.EdgeCount == self.MaxPossibleEdges;
```
